singleJudge.finding: [native] The main-panel divider lines (header line at y 72, tab-strip line at y 108) paint #313131, the input background's value, where the artboard paints #2b2b2b and the theme's settings.headerBorder resolves to #2b2b2b, so the divider is not in its role.

[native] The list pane paints sideBar.background (#181818, as the Design System's colour-role table gives the list pane) while the artboard paints the whole pane in editor.background (#1f1f1f), so the artboard and the rules disagree on this region's role.

[states] Rows without a package icon of their own show a multicoloured orange box with no tile, where the artboard draws its fallback as a monochrome codicon package glyph on a dark tile for the same packages (Newtonsoft.Json, Serilog), adding a decorative colour to the list.

[native] The sentence 'High severity' is painted in the warning colour, where the role table colours only the severity glyph and body text stays in its text role; it also says warning-yellow while the row's Vulnerable badge and the tab's count badge carry the error-red tone for the same package.

[native] Packages without their own icon show a saturated orange-yellow box (selected Newtonsoft.Json row; also Options, Http, AI.Abstractions and Serilog rows), where the artboard draws a neutral cube glyph in icon colour on a dark tile, so the list's strongest colour is decoration with no workbench role.

[states] The Installed value "12.0.1" starts at x 508, the version select's box edge, about 7 px left of the select's text at x 515; in the artboard the value and the select's text share one left edge (x 418).

[states] The list pane paints the darker side-bar surface (#181818) as the colour-role table requires (Side-bar surface, list pane: sideBar.background), while the artboard draws it in the same editor colour as the details pane (#1f1f1f); the artboard and the rules disagree.

refuted.finding: Unselected rows keep about 40 px empty at the end of the text column (text stops near x 270 to 282, the scrollbar starts at 318), so six rows read the same 'Microsoft.Extensions....' and cannot be told apart, and the 9.5.0-preview row's author collapses to '...'; the Extensions view gives the name the row's width when no action is drawn on that line.
refuted.reason: Crop shows ellipsized names, which DS-ROW-5 prescribes and hard DS-ROW-5 passes (14 rows, 7 names cut, badges clipped 0); the end space is the row action's slot (spec x 299, 6 px from the band end) and the shared id prefixes and long version are live content under rubric §6.

refuted.finding: The Installed tab has a second, red-outlined count badge '1' after its count badge; the artboard's tab has one count badge, and this unlabelled number beside '15' does not say what it counts.
refuted.reason: Crop shows the extra '1' badge, but the interaction model declares the Installed tab's count of packages with known vulnerabilities and this fixture has a Vulnerable row while the artboard's data has none; count values are live content under rubric §6 and hard DS-HEIGHT-10 passes (count 20.4×20, 26.7×20 ×3).

refuted.finding: The toolbar's two icon actions draw other glyphs than the artboard: refresh-button shows a two-arrow sync glyph where the artboard has a single-arrow refresh, and source-settings shows a cog where the artboard has its rayed glyph.
refuted.reason: Crop shows a cog and a sync glyph, both pinned codicons in docs/design/icons.json (settings-gear, sync), which is what DS-ICON-1 requires; the spec names no glyph, hard DS-ICON-2 passes (16×16 ×3, icon.foreground) and rubric §6 excludes glyph outlines.

refuted.finding: A row with a label badge spreads its two text lines further apart (name y 628 to version y 649, 21 px) than rows without one (y 197 to 216, 19 px), because the Vulnerable badge makes line 1 taller than its 20 px box, so the rhythm jumps between neighbouring rows.
refuted.reason: Sampled ink tops give 624 to 645 (21 px) on the badge row and 192 to 212 (20 px) on a plain row, not 19, so the jump is 1 px, within DS-ROW-1's 1 px tolerance and unseen in the crop; hard DS-ROW-1 reads 'centre offsets 0 ×28'.

refuted.finding: The Details tab content starts about 8 px below the strip line (line at y 213, description ink at y 225), while the redline gives the README content region below the same strip 20 px of padding, so the pane body looks squeezed against the artboard.
refuted.reason: The crop shows the description ink at y 225 under the line at y 213, but the redline's 20 px belongs to readme-content, the artboard draws the README tab rather than Details, and no rule sets this padding, so there is nothing comparable to call squeezed.
